The Blazor Web App is ready. Here's what was created:

**Project structure:**
```
RecipeCommunity/
├── Models/Recipe.cs              # Recipe & RecipeCategory models
├── Services/RecipeService.cs     # In-memory data with 8 seed recipes
├── Components/
│   ├── Pages/
│   │   ├── Home.razor            # Homepage with 6 category cards (static SSR)
│   │   ├── Category.razor        # Browse recipes by category (static SSR)
│   │   ├── RecipeDetail.razor    # Recipe page with star rating (static + interactive widget)
│   │   └── SubmitRecipe.razor    # Submit form (InteractiveServer)
│   ├── Shared/
│   │   ├── StarRating.razor      # Click-to-rate 1–5 stars (InteractiveServer)
│   │   └── StarRating.razor.css  # Scoped styles for rating widget
│   └── Layout/NavMenu.razor      # Nav with all categories + submit link
└── wwwroot/app.css               # Added category card hover effects
```

**Key design decisions:**
- **Per-component interactivity**: Only `StarRating` and `SubmitRecipe` use `@rendermode InteractiveServer`; all other pages are static SSR
- **RecipeService** registered as singleton with 8 seed recipes across 6 categories
- Star rating shows hover preview, persists rating, and updates the average in real-time
